startup.label: On startup
startup.description: What Cutweave opens when it starts.
startup.keywords: launch, open, begin, last project, empty, welcome

workspace.label: Workspace for new projects
workspace.description: The panel layout a new project opens with. Last used keeps the workspace you were in.
workspace.keywords: layout, panels, short-form, long-form, vertical, horizontal, new project

historyOrder.label: History order
historyOrder.description: Whether the History panel lists the oldest or the newest step first. The button in the panel changes the same setting.
historyOrder.keywords: history, undo, steps, sort, newest, oldest, order, panel

newProjectFolder.label: Folder for new projects
newProjectFolder.description: New project dialogs start in this folder.
newProjectFolder.keywords: location, directory, documents, path, create, save

recentCount.label: Recent projects to list
recentCount.description: How many projects File > Open recent shows.

clearRecent.label: Recent projects
clearRecent.description: Forget the projects listed in File > Open recent.

dialogChoices.label: “Don't ask again” choices
dialogChoices.description: Dialogs that remembered your answer will ask again.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Dark, light, or follow your system.
theme.keywords: color, colour, dark mode, light mode, night, appearance, system, os

interfaceScale.label: Interface scale
interfaceScale.description: The size of text and controls in every window. The preview and the timeline stay sharp.
interfaceScale.keywords: zoom, size, bigger, larger, smaller, text size, font size, ui scale, dpi, magnify, percent

density.label: Density
density.description: Comfortable makes controls, rows and tracks taller and adds room around them.
density.keywords: compact, spacing, padding, row height, track height, touch, roomy, cozy, tight

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: On makes menus, dialogs and controls change at once, with no fade. Match system follows your system's setting.
reduceMotion.keywords: animation, animations, transitions, fade, accessibility, motion sickness, vestibular, instant

exportFolder.label: Save exports in
exportFolder.description: Where the Export dialog proposes to save the file.
exportFolder.keywords: folder, directory, location, path, output, destination, video, mp4

exportFolderPath.label: Chosen folder
exportFolderPath.description: Used when exports go to a folder you choose.
exportFolderPath.keywords: folder, directory, location, path, output, destination, browse

exportLastFolder.label: Last folder used
exportLastFolder.description: The folder you last picked in the Export dialog.
exportLastFolder.keywords: folder, directory, location, path, recent, remembered, forget

exportPreset.label: Default preset
exportPreset.description: The preset the Export dialog starts at: the one you used last, or always this one.
exportPreset.keywords: export, preset, platform, youtube, tiktok, instagram, reels, shorts, format, default

exportLastPreset.label: Last preset used
exportLastPreset.description: The preset of the last export you started from the Export dialog.

exportFileName.label: File name
exportFileName.description: How exported files are named. {project}, {sequence}, {date} and {preset} are filled in; the extension follows the preset.
exportFileName.keywords: export, file name, filename, pattern, template, tokens, date, project, sequence

exportQuality.label: Default quality
exportQuality.description: The quality the Export dialog starts at for the H.264 MP4 1080p preset; other presets start at their own. You can change it for one export.
exportQuality.keywords: export, bitrate, size, render, video, low, medium, high

keepStructure.label: Keep folder structure when importing folders
keepStructure.description: Importing a folder makes a bin folder for each of its folders that holds media. Off puts every file straight into the open folder.
keepStructure.keywords: import, folder, directory, structure, hierarchy, bin, subfolders, flat

copyOnImport.label: Copy imported files into the project folder
copyOnImport.description: Each file you import is copied into the project's media folder first, so the project keeps working when the original is moved or deleted. The project must be saved first. Undoing an import leaves the copy on disk.
copyOnImport.keywords: import, copy, collect, consolidate, project folder, media folder, self-contained, portable, external drive

stillDuration.label: Still image duration
stillDuration.description: How long a photo or other still is when you place it on the timeline. New projects take this value; clips already on a timeline keep their length.
stillDuration.keywords: image, photo, picture, still, length, default, seconds, new project

linkAv.label: Keep video and audio linked
linkAv.description: A video you place on the timeline brings its sound as a linked clip, so the two move and trim together. Off: only the picture is placed.
linkAv.keywords: link, linked, sound, audio, video, insert, sync, unlink

dropMode.label: Dropping media onto a clip
dropMode.description: What happens when you drop media onto a clip outside the main track: it replaces what it covers, or it pushes the clip and everything after it later.
dropMode.keywords: drop, drag, overwrite, insert, replace, ripple, clip, media

nudge.label: Nudge step
nudge.description: How far comma and period move the selected clips. With Shift they move ten times as far.
nudge.keywords: nudge, move, comma, period, arrow, frame, step, shift

undoSteps.label: Undo steps
undoSteps.description: How many steps you can undo. Each agent keeps as many of its own. A lower number forgets the oldest steps at once.
undoSteps.keywords: undo, redo, history, steps, limit, levels, memory

snap.label: Snapping on when a project opens
snap.description: Whether snapping starts on. The magnet button on the timeline turns it on and off while you work.
snap.keywords: snap, snapping, magnet, default, open, project

snapTargets.label: Snap to
snapTargets.description: What a clip you drag or trim snaps to.
snapTargets.keywords: snap, playhead, clip edges, markers, beats, in, out, magnet

snapDistance.label: Snap distance
snapDistance.description: How close, on screen, a clip has to be before it snaps.
snapDistance.keywords: snap, distance, threshold, pixels, sensitivity, magnet

follow.label: Follow the playhead while playing
follow.description: Page turns the view when the playhead reaches its edge. Smooth keeps the playhead in the middle. Off leaves the view where it is.
follow.keywords: follow, playhead, scroll, play, page, smooth, auto scroll

magneticMain.label: Main track is magnetic in new sequences
magneticMain.description: Clips on the main track of a new project stay joined from the start: a drop pushes the rest along and a delete closes the space. Magnetic main track in a track's menu changes it for a sequence you already have.
magneticMain.keywords: magnetic, magnet, main track, ripple, gap, storyline, new project, new sequence

thumbnails.label: Video clip thumbnails
thumbnails.description: Filmstrip shows frames all along a clip, First frame shows one at its start, Off shows none.
thumbnails.keywords: thumbnail, filmstrip, frames, picture, clip, preview, first frame

waveforms.label: Audio waveforms on clips
waveforms.description: Draw the sound of audio clips on the timeline.

trackHeight.label: Height of new tracks
trackHeight.description: How tall a track is when it is added. Tracks you already have keep their height.
trackHeight.keywords: track, height, size, small, medium, large, row, lane

wheel.label: Mouse wheel
wheel.description: What the wheel does over the timeline. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) for the other one.
wheel.keywords: mouse, wheel, scroll, zoom, trackpad, ctrl, cmd

timeDisplay.label: Show time as
timeDisplay.description: How the timeline ruler, the time under the preview and the Inspector show time.
timeDisplay.keywords: time, timecode, frames, seconds, ruler, display, format

dropFrame.label: Drop-frame timecode
dropFrame.description: At 29.97 and 59.94 fps, show drop-frame timecode (with a semicolon), which keeps pace with the clock.
dropFrame.keywords: drop frame, timecode, 29.97, 59.94, ntsc, semicolon, non-drop

sequenceFormat.label: Format of new projects
sequenceFormat.description: The frame size, frame rate, audio sample rate and background a new project's sequences start with. To set it, choose "Use as defaults for new projects" in File > Project settings….
sequenceFormat.keywords: format, resolution, size, frame rate, fps, vertical, sequence, default, new project

qualityPlaying.label: Preview quality while playing
qualityPlaying.description: Auto shows full size and steps down only when your computer cannot keep up. Full, Half and Quarter always use that size; Full may skip frames on a heavy timeline.
qualityPlaying.keywords: resolution, performance, lag, stutter, smooth, dropped frames, half, quarter, full, auto, playback, preview, slow computer

qualityPaused.label: Preview quality when paused
qualityPaused.description: Full sharpens the picture to full size when playback stops. Same as playing leaves it at the size playback uses, which is quicker on a heavy timeline.
qualityPaused.keywords: resolution, pause, stopped, still, sharp, refine, full, auto, preview, scrub

previewProxies.label: Use proxies in the preview
previewProxies.description: Clips play and scrub from their proxies when those are ready and large enough for the preview. Off always reads the original files. Exports use the originals either way.
previewProxies.keywords: proxy, proxies, original, optimized media, smooth, performance, 4k, playback, scrub, preview

loopPlayback.label: Loop playback
loopPlayback.description: When playback reaches the end, it starts again from the beginning and keeps going until you pause.
loopPlayback.keywords: loop, repeat, cycle, again, continuous, end, restart, transport, play

returnToStart.label: Go back to where playback started
returnToStart.description: When you pause, or playback reaches the end, the playhead returns to where you pressed play. Off leaves it where playback stopped.
returnToStart.keywords: stop, pause, return, rewind, playhead, position, start, play, space, transport, preview

hoverScrub.label: Preview video on hover
hoverScrub.description: Moving the pointer across a video in the Media panel shows its frames. Off keeps the poster.
hoverScrub.keywords: scrub, hover, preview, thumbnail, filmstrip, poster, media panel, bin

exportHw.label: Hardware encoders
exportHw.description: Auto uses the graphics card's encoder when there is one, which is faster. Off always uses software.
exportHw.keywords: gpu, nvenc, amd, amf, quick sync, videotoolbox, acceleration, encode, render, export

autosave.label: Save automatically
autosave.description: Saves your project while you edit, so a crash costs little.
autosave.keywords: autosave, automatic, auto save, backup, crash

interval.label: Save at least every
interval.description: While you edit. Cutweave also saves 2 s after your last change.
interval.keywords: autosave, automatic, interval, how often, frequency, time

backups.label: Backups to keep
backups.description: Older backups of each project are deleted.
backups.keywords: autosave, automatic, backup, copies, history, restore

exportSettings.label: Export settings
exportSettings.description: Save your preferences to a file you can import on another computer.
exportSettings.keywords: backup, share, json, copy, transfer, save

importSettings.label: Import settings
importSettings.description: Apply the settings in a file. Invalid ones are skipped and listed.

resetAll.label: Reset all settings
resetAll.description: Put every setting back to its default. Projects, recent projects, window positions and keys are not touched.
resetAll.confirmMessage: Every setting goes back to its default. Your projects, recent projects, window positions and AI keys are not touched.

openSettingsFolder.label: Settings folder
openSettingsFolder.description: Show the folder that holds your preferences file.
openSettingsFolder.keywords: preferences.json, profile, user data, files, show, open

openLogsFolder.label: Logs folder
openLogsFolder.description: Show the folder with Cutweave's log files, for bug reports.
openLogsFolder.keywords: diagnostics, debug, errors, support, show, open

cacheFolder.label: Cache folder
cacheFolder.description: Where thumbnails, filmstrips, waveforms and frame indexes are kept. Projects and their media are never stored here. The old folder is left for you to delete.
cacheFolder.keywords: location, directory, path, disk, drive, move, temporary, storage

thumbnailsLimit.label: Thumbnails and filmstrips
thumbnailsLimit.description: The most disk space they may use. The oldest are deleted first, and they are drawn again when needed.
thumbnailsLimit.keywords: thumbnail, filmstrip, preview images, disk, space, size, limit, cache, clear

waveformsLimit.label: Waveforms
waveformsLimit.description: The most disk space the sound pictures of your clips may use. Lowering it deletes the oldest at once.
waveformsLimit.keywords: waveform, audio, sound, peaks, disk, space, size, limit, cache, clear

clearCaches.label: Clear all caches
clearCaches.description: Delete every thumbnail, filmstrip and waveform. Projects and generated media are not touched, and the caches fill again as you work.
clearCaches.keywords: delete, empty, free space, reset, purge, cache, storage
clearCaches.confirmMessage: Every thumbnail, filmstrip and waveform is deleted and drawn again when needed. Your projects, your media and generated media are not touched.

hwDecode.label: Hardware decoding
hwDecode.description: Let the graphics card decode video in the preview when it can. Turn it off if the preview shows glitches. Exports always decode in software.
hwDecode.keywords: gpu, nvdec, d3d11va, videotoolbox, vaapi, acceleration, decode, glitch, h264, hevc, playback

frameMemory.label: Memory for decoded frames
frameMemory.description: How much memory the preview may use to keep frames it has already decoded. Auto uses the smaller of 1 GB and a quarter of this computer's memory.
frameMemory.keywords: ram, memory, frame cache, preview, playback, scrub, performance

gpu.label: Graphics adapter
gpu.description: The graphics card (or software renderer) Cutweave draws the preview and exports with.
gpu.keywords: gpu, graphics, card, adapter, renderer, vulkan, dx12, metal, driver

hwEncoders.label: Hardware encoders found
hwEncoders.description: The video encoders on this computer that Export can use when hardware encoding is on.
hwEncoders.keywords: nvenc, amf, quick sync, videotoolbox, vaapi, encode, export, gpu

hwDecoders.label: Hardware decoders found
hwDecoders.description: The decoding paths on this computer that passed a test. The preview uses one when hardware decoding is Auto.
hwDecoders.keywords: nvdec, cuda, d3d11va, videotoolbox, vaapi, decode, gpu

agentNotices.label: Agent connections
agentNotices.description: Show a notice when an agent connects to this window or disconnects.
agentNotices.keywords: notify, notice, toast, agent, MCP, connected, disconnected, alert

agentStatus.label: Connection
agentStatus.description: Whether agents on this computer can reach this window.
agentStatus.keywords: agent, MCP, connect, status, attach, AI
agentStatus.ready: Agents can connect to this window
agentStatus.readyHint: An agent started with a setup below edits the project in the window you used last.
agentStatus.noEngine: Agents cannot connect right now: the engine is not running
agentStatus.noCli: Agents cannot connect: this build has no cutweave command-line tool

agentFolders.label: Folders agents can use
agentFolders.description: Agents may import media from, open projects in and save into these folders. The open project's folder is always allowed.
agentFolders.keywords: agent, MCP, folder, allow, access, path, import, permission, allow-root
agentFolders.empty: No folders yet: agents can use the open project's folder only.
agentFolders.full: The list is full. Remove a folder first.
agentFolders.invalid: That folder cannot be used: it does not exist any more.

clientProfile.label: Tools in copied setups
clientProfile.description: Which tool list an agent gets. Standard gives each client the list that suits it; the Claude Code setup then uses Described. Described is the standard tools with parameter descriptions, for clients that load a tool only when they need it. Minimal suits small context windows. Full lists the same tools as Standard for now.
clientProfile.keywords: agent, MCP, profile, tools, minimal, standard, described, full, context, parameters, tool search

connectClient.label: Connect a client
connectClient.description: Copy the setup for your agent app. It starts Cutweave's command-line tool, which connects to this window; no port or password is needed.
connectClient.keywords: agent, MCP, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, stdio, setup, config, connect, copy

where.claude-desktop: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings, Developer, Edit Config), then restart Claude Desktop.
where.cursor: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, or .cursor/mcp.json in a project.
where.stdio: Any MCP client: start this command as a stdio server.

connectClient.copyFailed: The setup could not be copied.
connectClient.none: No setup to copy: this build has no cutweave command-line tool.

connectedAgents.label: Connected agents
connectedAgents.description: The agents connected to this window now, and the last thing each asked for.
connectedAgents.keywords: agent, MCP, connected, who, sessions, last command, activity

imageSequenceFps.label: Frame rate for image sequences
imageSequenceFps.description: The frame rate a numbered run of pictures gets when you import it as an image sequence. Sequences you have already imported keep theirs.
imageSequenceFps.keywords: image sequence, frames, fps, frame rate, numbered pictures, render, time-lapse, png, exr, import

proxiesLimit.label: Proxies
proxiesLimit.description: Smaller copies of video that is slow to scrub. When the limit is reached, the proxies used longest ago are removed; the original files are never touched.
proxiesLimit.keywords: proxy proxies cache limit size disk space storage

proxyJobs.label: Proxy jobs at once
proxyJobs.description: How many proxies are made at the same time. More finishes sooner and uses more of the computer. Only one runs while an export does.
proxyJobs.keywords: proxy proxies jobs background parallel concurrent cpu

proxyPolicy.label: Proxies for new projects
proxyPolicy.description: Which video gets a proxy in a new project. Auto makes one for H.264 and HEVC video that is slow to scrub: larger than 1920 pixels, faster than 60 fps, or 10-bit HEVC.
proxyPolicy.keywords: proxy proxies policy automatic new project scrub

proxySize.label: Proxy size
proxySize.description: The longest side of a proxy picture, in pixels. Smaller proxies scrub faster and take less space. A new size applies to proxies made from now on.

exportDone.label: Finished exports
exportDone.description: Notify when an export finishes while Cutweave is in the background.
exportDone.keywords: notify, notification, export, done, finished, complete, background, alert

exportSound.label: Export sound
exportSound.description: Play a sound when an export finishes.
exportSound.keywords: notify, sound, chime, audio, export, done, finished, complete

performance.noGpu: None in use (the CPU draws, or the graphics card is still starting)

shortcuts.note: Every shortcut in Cutweave. Pick a preset, then record your own keys: only your changes are stored, so a preset updated later still reaches you.

menu.new: File menu. Starts a new project.
menu.open: File menu. Opens a project from disk.
menu.saveAs: File menu. Saves the project under a new name.
menu.collect: File menu. Copies the project and all its media into one folder.
menu.archive: File menu. Bundles the project, its media and a checked file list into one folder or zip file.
menu.projectSettings: File menu. Opens the settings saved in this project.
menu.export: File menu. Opens the Export dialog once the timeline has clips.
menu.undo: Edit menu. Takes back the last edit.
menu.redo: Edit menu. Brings back an edit you took back.
menu.cut: Edit menu. Cuts the selected text.
menu.copy: Edit menu. Copies the selected text.
menu.selectAll: Edit menu. Selects all the text in a field.
menu.fullScreen: View menu. Fills the screen with the window.
menu.reload: View menu, development builds only. Reloads the window.
menu.devTools: View menu, development builds only. Shows the developer tools.
menu.commandPalette: Opens the command palette: search every command, panel and setting and run it.
menu.newSequence: File menu. Adds a sequence in the project's format and shows it.
menu.sequenceSettings: File menu. Opens the size, frame rate and background of the sequence that shows.
menu.nextSequence: View menu. Shows the sequence of the next tab above the timeline.
menu.previousSequence: View menu. Shows the sequence of the previous tab above the timeline.

playback.togglePlayHelp: Starts or stops playback from the playhead.
playback.reverseHelp: Plays in reverse. Each press while it plays backwards makes it faster.
playback.forwardHelp: Plays forwards. Each press while it plays makes it faster.
playback.stepBackHelp: Moves the playhead back by one frame.
playback.stepForwardHelp: Moves the playhead forward by one frame.

source.backHelp: Source view. Returns the Preview to the timeline.
source.insertHelp: Source view. Puts the marked range (the whole clip without marks) on the timeline at the playhead; what is there moves later.
source.overwriteHelp: Source view. Puts the marked range on the timeline at the playhead, over what is there.
source.markInHelp: Source view. Marks where the part to place starts, at the source's playhead.
source.markOutHelp: Source view. Marks where the part to place ends, at the source's playhead.
source.clearMarks: Clear the source in and out
source.clearMarksHelp: Source view. Removes both marks of the clip.

timeline.cancelHelp: Timeline. Stops a drag, trim or marquee and puts everything back.
timeline.splitHelp: Timeline. Cuts the selected clips where the playhead is, or the clip under it when none is selected.
timeline.snappingHelp: Timeline. Makes clips and the playhead stick to edges, or not.
timeline.duplicateHelp: Timeline. Copies the selected clips right after themselves. Cut, Copy and Paste work with the Edit menu keys while the timeline has the focus.
timeline.renameTrackHelp: Timeline. Edits the name of the selected track in its header. Double-click the name does the same.
timeline.rippleDeleteHelp: Timeline. Removes the selected clips and closes the gap they leave.
timeline.nudgeLeftHelp: Timeline. Moves the selected clips one frame to the left.
timeline.nudgeRightHelp: Timeline. Moves the selected clips one frame to the right.
timeline.nudgeLeftFarHelp: Timeline. Moves the selected clips ten frames to the left.
timeline.nudgeRightFarHelp: Timeline. Moves the selected clips ten frames to the right.
timeline.selectAllHelp: Timeline. Selects every clip of the sequence.
timeline.addMarkerHelp: Timeline. Puts a marker at the playhead.
timeline.markInHelp: Timeline. Marks where the range starts, at the playhead.
timeline.markOutHelp: Timeline. Marks where the range ends, at the playhead.
timeline.toolSelectHelp: Timeline. Click to select, drag a clip to move it, drag an edge to trim.
timeline.toolRippleHelp: Timeline. Drag an edge to trim; what follows moves with it.
timeline.toolRollHelp: Timeline. Drag a cut between two clips; the total length stays the same.
timeline.toolSlipHelp: Timeline. Drag a clip to change which part of its media it shows.
timeline.toolSlideHelp: Timeline. Drag a clip between its neighbours; they shorten and lengthen around it.
timeline.toolRazorHelp: Timeline. Click a clip to split it there; Shift splits every track.
timeline.toolHandHelp: Timeline. Drag to scroll the timeline.
timeline.toolZoomHelp: Timeline. Click to zoom in, Alt+click to zoom out, drag to zoom to a range.
timeline.matchFrameHelp: Timeline. Opens the clip under the playhead in the Source view at the same frame.
timeline.keyframeLanesHelp: Timeline. Opens the keyframe lanes under the selected clips, or closes them.
timeline.keyframeNextHelp: Timeline. Selects the next keyframe of the selected clip and moves the playhead to it.
timeline.keyframePreviousHelp: Timeline. Selects the previous keyframe of the selected clip and moves the playhead to it.

preview.nudgeHelp: Preview handles. Moves the selected clips by 1 pixel of the sequence, 10 with Shift. Works while the picture has the focus.
preview.toggleCropHelp: Preview handles. Switches the selected clip's handles between scaling and cropping.

bin.moveHelp: Media bin. Moves the focus between clips, or up and down a row.
bin.edgesHelp: Media bin. Moves the focus to the first or the last clip.
bin.insertHelp: Media bin. Puts the focused clip on the timeline at the playhead.
bin.playHelp: Media bin. Selects the focused clip and plays or pauses it in the Preview.
bin.removeHelp: Media bin. Removes the focused clip, after asking when it is used.
bin.importHelp: Opens the file picker to add media. Works anywhere in the app.
bin.importFolderHelp: Opens the folder picker and imports each folder with its subfolders as bin folders. Works anywhere in the app.
bin.searchHelp: Media bin. Moves the focus to the search field.
bin.upHelp: Media bin. Goes to the folder that holds the open one.
bin.renameHelp: Media bin. Renames the focused folder or clip in place.
bin.newFolderHelp: Media bin. Creates a folder in the open one and starts renaming it.

dialogs.closeHelp: Closes the dialog or menu, clears a search, or puts back the text you were editing.
dialogs.confirmHelp: Presses the dialog's main button, or keeps the text you typed.
dialogs.nextHelp: Moves the focus through the buttons and fields.

preset.label: Shortcut preset
preset.description: Cutweave's own keys, or keys that feel like CapCut. Your changes below stay on top of whichever you pick.
preset.keywords: keymap, keyboard layout, capcut, premiere, resolve, nle

reset.label: Reset all shortcuts
reset.description: Puts the preset and every key back to the Cutweave defaults.
reset.confirmMessage: Every shortcut you changed goes back to the Cutweave preset. Your other settings stay as they are.

export.label: Export shortcuts
export.description: Saves your preset and changed keys to a file, to keep or to use on another computer.

import.label: Import shortcuts
import.description: Replaces your preset and changed keys with the ones in a file made by Export shortcuts.

notices.reset: All shortcuts are back to the Cutweave preset.

cell.commandHelp: Runs from the command palette too.

about.title: About {{name}}
about.tagline: An open-source video editor for creators and the AI agents that work with them.
about.license: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.

recovered.title: Layout reset
recovered.body: The saved panel layout could not be restored, so the default layout is showing.

suggest.title: This is a vertical video
suggest.body: Short-form puts a tall preview in the middle and the timeline underneath.

empty.title: Every panel is closed
empty.body: Reopen the panels you had, or start again from the default layout.

panelCrashed.title: {{name}} stopped working
panelCrashed.body: The rest of the editor is fine. Reload the panel to try again.

popoutFailed.title: The panel could not open in a new window
popoutFailed.body: It stays in the main window. Try again, or use Float panel.

media.title: No media yet
media.body: Drop video, audio or images here, or press Ctrl+I to import.

audio.title: No audio yet
audio.body: Music, sound effects and voiceovers appear here. Import a file or record a voiceover.

text.title: Text styles
text.body: Titles, lower thirds and subtitles appear here once the text library is installed.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.body: Stickers and shapes you add to a project appear here.

effects.title: Effects
effects.body: Effects you can apply to a clip appear here, grouped by what they change.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.body: Transitions between two clips appear here. Select a cut on the timeline to apply one.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Color looks and filters appear here, with a strength slider in the inspector.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Project templates and compositions appear here. Start from one to skip the setup.

captions.title: Captions
captions.body: Generate captions from speech or import an SRT file. Caption styles appear here.

ai-studio.title: AI Studio
ai-studio.body: Generate clips, images and voices. Each action shows its cost and model before it runs.

card.usedTipOne: On a timeline: 1 clip uses it
card.usedTipMany: On a timeline: {{count}} clips use it

noMatch.body: Check the spelling, or loosen the filters.

drop.title: Drop to import
drop.body: Release to add the files to this project.

import.desktopOnly: Importing files needs the Cutweave desktop app.

reason.unsupported: This file has no video or audio Cutweave can play. Try another file.
reason.io: The file could not be read. Check its permissions and try again.
reason.invalid: The file's details are not usable. Try exporting it again from its source.
reason.notFound: The file is missing. Check that it still exists and try again.
reason.timedOut: Reading the file took too long. Try again, or copy it to a local drive.

remove.confirmBody: {{count}} clips on the timeline use it.
remove.confirmNote: The engine only removes media that no clip uses. If it refuses, delete those clips first. The file on disk is never touched.

folder.emptyBody: Drag media here, or import into it.
folder.renamedOne: Moved. 1 folder was renamed because its name was taken.
folder.renamedMany: Moved. {{count}} folders were renamed because their names were taken.
folder.moveHint: Choose the folder to move the selection into.
folder.deleteUsedOne: 1 is used on the timeline and will move to “{{parent}}”.
folder.deleteUsedMany: {{count}} are used on the timeline and will move to “{{parent}}”.
folder.deleteNote: Keep media lifts everything into the parent folder. Files on disk are never touched, and Undo brings it all back.

sequence.offerNote: As an image sequence, the numbered pictures in that folder become one item that plays like video. The files stay where they are.
sequence.duplicate: This sequence was in the project already.
